name: Mai Miko Moe "Nii-sama... Watashi, Miko Janaku Nacchau..."
original_name: 妹巫女・萌 「にいさま…私、巫女じゃなくなっちゃう…」
source:
Tomoya's parents' home was a famous shrine in the area and his father was a Shinto priest. Tomoya was disciplined severely by his parents to take over the shrine. After his parents passed away in the fire, his grandfather disciplined him more severely. He couldn't take it anymore and ran away after graduating from junior high school. Several years later, he receives a letter. That is to inform that his grandfather has passed away. He decided not to go back before but he returns home one last time. He remembers good old days and childhood memories in the bus, especially Moe, who was saved by his parents and brought up with him...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090103025007/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1005359]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
朋也的父母的家是该地区著名的神社，他的父亲是一位神道牧师。朋也为了接管神社而受到父母的严厉管教。父母在火灾中去世后，祖父对他的管教更加严厉。他再也无法忍受，初中毕业后就离家出走了。几年后，他收到一封信。那就是通知他的祖父去世了。他决定不再回去，但他最后一次回家了。他回忆起公交车上的美好时光和童年回忆，尤其是被父母救下并和他一起长大的莫伊……

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090103025007/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1005359]工口游戏商店[/url]]
